tools.name: wall_status
tools.description: Read the live status of the twentyone million wall. Free. No wallet and no payment. Returns the JSON from /api/status.

tools.name: claim_square
tools.description: Claim one square on the twentyone million wall. $1 USDC on Base, paid over x402 by your own wallet. This server does not pay and does not hold a key. The result is the wall's HTTP 402 payment requirements for the claim URL. Sign that challenge and retry the claim POST with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE head

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: claim_square · Private data: wall_status, claim_square · Public sink: claim_square.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: claim_square · Private data: wall_status, claim_square · Public sink: claim_square

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
